footer.summary: SurvivalRPG - Dota 2 custom game with seasons, public rankings, SteamID progress and an admin panel.
guide.title: First steps
guide.lead: This guide explains the basic flow: enter, choose a hero, progress through zones, collect items, craft and save progress.
guide.step1.title: 1. Sign in with Steam
guide.step1.text: Your SteamID identifies your account. Each hero keeps separate level, gold, inventory, quests and active pet.
guide.step2.title: 2. Choose a hero role
guide.step2.text: Tank, ranged DPS, assassin, mage, healer and support progress differently. Check the catalog before deciding.
guide.step3.title: 3. Clear Zone 0 and Zone 1
guide.step3.text: Start with basic resources, defeat camps and reach the zone boss to open gates.
guide.step4.title: 4. Craft and upgrade
guide.step4.text: Crafts can roll from tier 1 to 5. Shop items are fixed and helpful, but do not replace crafts or drops.
guide.step5.title: 5. Save progress
guide.step5.text: Use the save progress button when available to store your state even if the character is dead.
